purpose: Describe, patient by patient, the source-defined D0 patients who contribute to the difference between the source end-to-end acute-care outcome population and the fixed/shared outcome population, and determine whether their downstream acute-care risk differs from the shared population.

audit_populations.source_end_to_end: Locked source D0 patients satisfying source-specific 30-day or 90-day observability.
audit_populations.fixed_shared: Locked source D0 patients whose selected D0 episode materialized in lineage-faithful OMOP, whose source and OMOP index dates are exact, and who satisfy both source and OMOP observability for the outcome window.
audit_populations.source_only_complement: Source end-to-end eligible patients who are not in the corresponding fixed/shared outcome population. This population is defined directly at patient level rather than only by subtracting aggregate counts.

required_outputs: D0 source, lineage-faithful OMOP, and source-only membership counts
source-only membership counts stratified by recorded versus missing selected diagnosis date
30-day source end-to-end, fixed/shared, and source-only-complement eligible counts, events, and risks
90-day source end-to-end, fixed/shared, and source-only-complement eligible counts, events, and risks
risk difference and risk ratio comparing source-only complement with fixed/shared source risk
decomposition of the source-only complement into loss of lineage-faithful OMOP D0 membership, target-observability-only loss, and index-date mismatch
explicit verification that fixed/shared plus source-only complement reconstructs the source end-to-end counts and events
interpretation_guardrails: Outcome differences in the source-only complement may demonstrate outcome-associated selective loss but do not by themselves identify a causal selection effect.
Do not classify missingness as MCAR, MAR, or MNAR from this audit.
Do not treat this post-outcome audit as a prespecified primary analysis.
Do not alter the frozen ETL, D0 definition, Stage D outcome definition, or empirical reproducibility tolerances in response to this audit.
